findings.description: r-2b `adrs` lacks ADR-SAG-0029. r-2b owns crates/sc-jev-check/src/registry/scripted.rs (line 45) and extends register_scripted_backends with the per-backend JSON form. It states that 'the ADR-SAG-0029 (b) string shorthand' stays (D5 line 138; line 184: 'supersedes no ADR-SAG-0029 sentence, and 0029 (b)'s shorthand rule stands'). It also amends ADR-SAG-0022, which 0029 amends. 0029 (b) therefore governs the deliverable, and the list names 0022 but not 0029.
findings.remediation: Add `- ADR-SAG-0029` to the r-2b `adrs` frontmatter, after ADR-SAG-0025.

findings.description: r-3c `adrs` lacks ADR-SAG-0029. r-3c replaces the sc-treesitter argv parser with clap and keeps 'the code current tests expect' on stderr (D2). It also moves git blob reads to the shared git module (owned_paths: main.rs, cli/**, git_io.rs). ADR-SAG-0029 (c) fixes the sc-treesitter CLI error codes: a missing positional is INPUT_INVALID; a revision starting with '-' or a bad path or revision is INPUT_INVALID; a blob over 8 MiB is INPUT_TOO_LARGE. It also covers io_failed and encode_failed mapping. These govern r-3c's paths and deliverables.
findings.remediation: Add `- ADR-SAG-0029` to the r-3c `adrs` frontmatter. Add an acceptance line that the clap errors and shared git reads keep the 0029 (c) dispositions.
